tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Obsidian is the default theme; Paper is the daylight-and-print theme.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, nav bar, tags: one step above the page.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Featured cards and popovers: the one surface that comes forward.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed evidence: hero stage, AgentTrace, Terminal, card visuals.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, card borders, dot-grid pattern. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (secondary Button), metric rules, hovered card borders, cover blocks. ≥ 3:1 on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, surfaces, signal-soft and current-soft (≥ 11:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Paragraphs, ledes, metadata on bg and all surfaces (≥ 6:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps, durations, numbering. Small mono text on bg and surfaces only (≥ 4.5:1); never sentences.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The glow — ice silver-white on Obsidian, deep steel on Paper. Primary Button fill, ContactBand ground, the agent core, model/result nodes. Once per view. Fill only: as text use signal-ink.

tokens.name: signal-strong
tokens.usage: Hover state of signal fills; on-signal stays readable (≥ 11:1).

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: The glow as text: the italic accent word, index numbers, prompts. On bg and all surfaces (≥ 6:1). On Obsidian it carries the glow-text shadow.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and marks on signal or signal-strong (Obsidian 16:1, Paper 14:1).

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for signal Tags and the halo around live nodes. Text on it is ink or signal-ink.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Decorative planes only: cover blocks, illustration fills. Never behind text.

tokens.name: sheen
tokens.usage: Metallic highlight: the 1px top-edge light on cards and the diagonal sheen across stages. Decorative only.

tokens.name: current
tokens.usage: Mint — the connective colour: MCP and tool nodes, live edges, availability status. Differs from the ice signal in lightness and hue.

tokens.name: current-ink
tokens.usage: Mint as text: MCP/tool step kinds, outcome labels, success lines in Terminal. On bg and all surfaces (≥ 5.8:1).

tokens.name: on-current
tokens.usage: Text on a current fill (Obsidian 11:1, Paper 5.3:1).

tokens.name: current-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for current Tags (status, availability). Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and failed steps only, always with a word. On bg and all surfaces (≥ 5.3:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset — the ice glow on Obsidian, steel on Paper (≥ 12:1 on every surface). Inside ContactBand it switches to on-signal.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero name only. One per page. The second word may be italic in signal-ink.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: ContactBand title and big metric values.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: I architect agentic AI for the enterprise.
styles.usage: Hero statement and the first paragraph of a case study, in ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The agent checks permissions before it ever touches a table.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Set in UPPERCASE. Section indices, eyebrows, labels. The only place letterspacing opens up.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Tags and stack chips, sentence or proper case.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: icon to text inside a Tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight clusters: tag rows, step internals.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button groups, label-to-value gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inner padding of compact panels; facet unit on the cover.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutters, section-header gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero column gap, ContactBand side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero and ContactBand vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between page sections. Generous air is the luxury signal; never compress it below space-8 on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, focus outlines — the sharp, machined corner.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Nav monogram, card visuals, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, Terminal, AgentTrace, nav bar.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Stages: Hero and ContactBand only. Nothing in this system is round; nodes are diamonds.

shadow.note: Elevation is borders plus a 1px sheen. Glows mark the one live or primary thing.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: ProjectCard on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Primary Button on hover — the ice glow.

tokens.name: glow-text
tokens.usage: text-shadow on the italic signal-ink accent (Hero name, section titles). Off on Paper.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the page frame.

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: Max width of case-study body copy (≈ 68ch at body).

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: NavBar height; offset for sticky anchors.
